all_quotes.quote: Located at 156 pc (cite: Gaia+2022)
We investigate the properties of the observed SO emission in the protoplanetary disk of AB Auriga, a Herbig Ae star of 2.4 $\,\mathrm{M}_\odot$ located at 156 pc.
These observations confirm that SO is a good tracer of shocks in protoplanetary disks and could be a powerful, new tool to detect embedded (proto-)planets.
This paper makes use of the following ALMA data: ADS/JAO.ALMA#2019.1.00579.S, ADS/JAO.ALMA#2021.1.00690.S and ADS/JAO.ALMA#2021.1.01216.S.
